import pytest
from apimd.parser import doctest

def test_doctest_wraps_single_example(tmp_path):
    """Test that a single doctest line is wrapped correctly."""
    input_doc = ">>> print('hello')\n'hello'"
    expected = (
        "```python\n"
        ">>> print('hello')\n"
        "```'\n"
        "'hello'"
    )
    result = doctest(input_doc)
    assert result == expected

def test_doctest_handles_multiple_examples(tmp_path):
    """Test that multiple doctest blocks are wrapped separately."""
    input_doc = (
        ">>> a = 1\n"
        ">>> a\n"
        "1\n"
        ">>> b = 2\n"
        ">>> b\n"
        "2"
    )
    expected = (
        "```python\n"
        ">>> a = 1\n"
        ">>> a\n"
        "1\n"
        "```\n"
        ">>> b = 2\n"
        ">>> b\n"
        "2"
    )
    result = doctest(input_doc)
    assert result == expected

def test_doctest_no_doctest_lines(tmp_path):
    """Test that a docstring with no doctest lines is returned unchanged."""
    input_doc = "This is a normal docstring.\nIt has multiple lines."
    result = doctest(input_doc)
    assert result == input_doc
```
